title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The rest of the display sweep
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.4 finishes the display sweep started in 1.42.3 with the four items that audit left open: a vector preview that could not be read on a light theme, theme colours that rendered black, a decoration leak in the inline drawable icon, and an Android project view that duplicated every module and never noticed a new file.

highlights.title: Vector preview readable on light themes
highlights.description: The checkerboard was two hard coded dark greys, so a black icon vanished on a light theme. It is now drawn over the editor background, and theme colours (?attr/…, @color/…) convert to currentColor instead of an invalid black paint.

highlights.title: Android project view without duplicates
highlights.description: An "app (root)" pseudo module globbed the whole workspace and repeated every module's manifests and res folders. The view now lists the declared modules plus one Gradle Scripts node, and refreshes when a source or resource file is created or deleted.

highlights.title: Gutter icon types released
highlights.description: Every distinct SVG minted a decoration type and a cache file that were never disposed, so typing in a vector file grew both for the whole session. Only what a visible editor shows is kept.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Converts ?attr/…, @color/… and @android:color/… colours to currentColor; passed verbatim they were an invalid paint, meaning a black fill and no stroke.
Refreshes the Android project view when a Kotlin, Java, XML or image file is created or deleted, one refresh per burst, paths under build/ ignored, nothing while the view is hidden.
